personalInfo.name: Jung Gu
personalInfo.title: Software Engineer | Cloud & Automation
personalInfo.summary: Software engineer building C# and Python services on Azure, with a focus on automation, PostgreSQL data layers, and containerized deployments. Led a VM-to-container migration that made deployments 5x faster and cut infrastructure cost 80%, and keep medical device tracking at 99.9% uptime across 100k+ monthly transactions.

experience.description:
• Led the migration from virtual machines to Azure Container Apps Jobs (Docker), building the C# and Python services that run on it; deployments 5x faster, infrastructure cost down 80%.
• Automated the shipment data pipeline in Python and C# on scheduled Azure container jobs, writing to PostgreSQL and cutting manual processing by 40%.
• Engineered a high-availability API gateway on Azure API Management, backed by C# services, for real-time tracking across third-party partners.
• Own the PostgreSQL data layer behind medical device tracking for Stryker: 99.9% uptime and 100% data accuracy across 100k+ monthly transactions.

• Worked within an Agile (Scrum) team to deliver a high-performance TypeScript/React landing page, implementing lazy loading and component optimization to Increase consultation requests by 35%.
• Optimized website performance through code refactoring and modern development practices, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

• Developed client communication system integrating Mailchimp API for automated email workflows, reducing manual follow-ups by 30%.
• Optimized website performance by diagnosing issues via Google Analytics (e.g., bounce rates, exit pages) and implementing UI/SEO fixes that grew traffic 25% MoM.
